defects: Zoubida's raised right hand clips into her chin and lower lip while her mouth forms an unnatural black triangle.
Her eyes are wide open instead of squinting up at the ceiling beams as directed for b005.
The right sleeve mesh pinches with jagged ink lines at the inner elbow and wrist fold.
tiles.fix: Pull Zoubida's right hand slightly forward off her chin or raise it to shade her brow, narrow her eyelids into a squint directed toward the ceiling beams, and clean up the right elbow sleeve fold.

defects: Zoubida stands in a stiff, lifeless neutral mannequin pose with both arms hanging straight down and a blank downward gaze that fails to sell declaring 'total war'.
Flat character shading and missing ambient/ground occlusion prevent her from integrating with the warm directional sunlight of the bedroom plate.
tiles.fix: Pose Zoubida in an assertive, determined stance (e.g. hands on hips or rolling up her sleeves) with a fierce eye-line scanning the room.

defects: Only the first enumeration insert ('Chaux') is shown for b006 while the subsequent cuts for 'Soufre' and 'Pétrole' specified by the director are missing from the beat sequence.
tiles.fix: Cut to the 'Soufre' and 'Pétrole' insert plates on their respective spoken words in the enumeration.

defects: Missing core acting gesture for b007: Zoubida is supposed to reach up toward the top of the door on the left to place a talisman, but both arms remain down at her sides.
Zoubida's left hand clips into her yellow waist sash and hip.
Her left foot is swallowed inside the skirt mesh while only the right toe pokes out, and her feet lack contact shadows on the floor tiles.
tiles.fix: Raise Zoubida's left or right arm high toward the upper door lintel as if tucking a talisman over the doorframe, pull the other hand clear of the sash, and expose both shoes cleanly on the floor plane.

defects: Zoubida reuses a robotic pose with her right fist pressed into her chin and her left arm hanging rigidly in a default A-pose with splayed fingers.
The camera framing cuts off well below the ceiling so the cedar beams she is peering at are completely out of frame.
tiles.fix: Tilt or reframe the camera slightly higher (or step Zoubida further back into the room) so her upward gaze clearly targets the ceiling beams, and relax her stiff left arm.

defects: The dish cloth (torchon) is a rigid, flat triangular polygon sticking horizontally out from the back of Zoubida's right wrist instead of a hanging or whipping cloth.
Zoubida's raised right hand and forearm press into her forehead and headscarf with severe sleeve mesh pinching at the elbow and armpit, while her left arm hangs completely dead in an A-pose.
tiles.fix: Attach a properly draped/deformed cloth mesh gripped inside Zoubida's right hand and animate a dynamic full-body whipping swing across the room with torso twist and active left-arm counterbalance.

defects: Zoubida is completely frozen in the exact same broken pose as s03 48.7 with the rigid polygon cloth protruding from her wrist and her left arm hanging stiffly at her side.
No flies are visible exiting through the window on the right wall, and Zoubida neither whips the cloth toward the window nor looks in its direction.
tiles.fix: Follow through the cloth-whipping gesture toward the right-hand window with Zoubida's body and eye-line turned toward the window, and add the animated flies escaping out the window.

worst_problem: In b007 (s03 28.8) Zoubida fails to reach up toward the door to place the talisman, and in b009 (s03 48.7 and s03 53.1) she is frozen in a half-A-pose with a rigid flat polygon sticking horizontally out of her wrist instead of whipping a dish cloth to chase flies out the window.
